name: 2025-2c-parcial2
title: BAJE public transport card readers
description: Model the card readers of Buenos Aires buses, subways and trains charging trips on a BAJE card: routes with stops and distance-based fare tables, card discount configurations (none, student, retiree), transfer discounts within 2 hours, and train entry/exit fare adjustment. The student must build the whole model with TDD from an empty test class.

design.notes: Three reader kinds with different charging moments (bus on tap, subway fixed, train entry then optional exit refund), three discount policies and a non-cumulative transfer rule interact on a card that records its trips and per-day free trips, so the hard part is assigning responsibilities among reader, transport, fare table, card, discount and trip objects and using Chalten/Aconcagua for dates and units.
